alt: January 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of a young woman in a flowing yellow skirt flying a kite on a grassy hill below a palace, birds in a blue sky. New Year, Sankranti and Republic Day are marked.
caption: A watercolor illustration of a person flying a kite under a blue sky with clouds and birds.
description: This artwork shows a figure in a flowing orange and blue dress standing on a hill, arm extended upward releasing a colorful kite. The background features a large wash of blue watercolor representing the sky, scattered with white birds, set above a silhouette of a domed building.
